description: This file defines a class 'Gdpr' within the 'Opencart.Catalog.Controller.Cron' namespace. The class extends a framework controller and contains a method 'index' that manages GDPR-related cron tasks such as expiring GDPR entries and deleting customers based on GDPR data.
